description: Sends a message to the people who run Fuzzframe; one of them reads it on their phone and answers in the person's chat on fuzzframe.com (the chat button in the bottom corner of the app). Use it when the person asks for a human or for support, or when something on Fuzzframe's side keeps failing and you can't get around it (an error that repeats, a stuck video, credits or billing that look wrong, connecting). Ask them first, unless they asked for it. Write it as from them: what they wanted, what happened, the error word for word and the video's id or address. Free.

message.description: What they wanted, what happened and any error, word for word

video.description: The video's id or address, when it is about one
